description: This file defines the public interface for FreeType renderer modules, including function pointer types for glyph operations, renderer class structures, and functions to get and set renderers within the FreeType library.

classes.name: FT_Glyph_Class_
classes.description: Structure defining glyph object operations and properties.

classes.name: FT_Renderer_Class_
classes.description: Structure defining renderer module class, including rendering and transformation functions.

methods.name: FT_Get_Renderer
methods.description: Retrieves the current renderer for a specified glyph format.

methods.name: FT_Set_Renderer
methods.description: Sets the current renderer for the library with optional parameters.
